title: Проглоченное кольцо и истории косяков  (The Swallowed Ring and Stories of Blunders)

scenes.title: Наказание Макса и закрытый вход  (Max's Punishment and the VIP Entrance)
scenes.summary: Working without days off after losing both Vika and Sasha, Max wonders what sins he committed in a past life while watching rich VIP guests arrive at Claude Monet.

scenes.title: Чужое парковочное место  (Someone Else's Parking Spot)
scenes.summary: Max tries to defend Chef Barinov's parking spot in the courtyard, only to accidentally insult the restaurant's wealthy VIP guest and embarrass the Chef.

scenes.title: Как Сеня устраивался на работу  (How Senya Got Hired)
scenes.summary: To cheer Max up after his blunder in front of the Chef, Senya and Fedya recall how they each screwed up on their very first day in Barinov's kitchen.

scenes.title: Фальшивый шеф и счастливая борода  (The Fake Chef and the Lucky Beard)
scenes.summary: In Senya's flashback, the real Chef Barinov walks in to find a drunken impostor interviewing Senya, and in Fedya's flashback Barinov orders Fedya to shave his lucky beard.

scenes.title: Проигрыш «Спартака» и сбритая борода  (Spartak's Loss and the Shaved Beard)
scenes.summary: When Spartak loses a match during Fedya's shift, a furious Chef Barinov blames Fedya's supposedly lucky beard and chases him down to shave it off.

scenes.title: Шутка Луи над Шефом  (Louis's Prank on the Chef)
scenes.summary: Louis recounts how he once greeted a hungover Chef Barinov with a loud joke about alcohol destroying his brain before his liver.

scenes.title: Секретный салат для постоянного гостя  (The Secret Salad for a Regular Guest)
scenes.summary: When Max doubts that obedient sous-chef Lyova ever messed up, Chef Barinov tells the story of a wealthy regular guest who only ate Barinov's warm seafood salad.

scenes.title: Любопытный Лёва пробует салат  (Curious Lyova Tastes the Salad)
scenes.summary: In Barinov's flashback, Lyova is determined to discover the secret ingredient in the Chef's warm seafood salad and secretly eats an entire plate of it himself.

scenes.title: Особый ингредиент в салате  (The Special Ingredient in the Salad)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov reveals to a horrified Lyova that he crushes potency pills into the elderly guest's seafood salad so the old man can impress his young companions.

scenes.title: Лёд для Лёвы и вызов к хозяину  (Ice for Lyova and a Summons to the Owner)
scenes.summary: In the end of the flashback, Nastya brings a mortified Lyova a bucket of ice, and in the present Chef Barinov tells Max to go apologize to the VIP guest in the dining room.

scenes.title: Субординация и месяц без зарплаты  (Insubordination and a Month Without Pay)
scenes.summary: Max tries to talk to the VIP guest in the dining room only to sit down at Nagiyev's table by mistake, earning himself a month of unpaid work for insubordination.

scenes.title: Как облажался сам Шеф  (How the Chef Himself Screwed Up)
scenes.summary: Late at night in the office, Lyova asks Chef Barinov if he has ever committed a huge blunder himself, prompting a flashback to when Kristina first visited as a guest.

scenes.title: Воспоминание о первой встрече с Кристиной  (Flashback to First Meeting Kristina)
scenes.summary: In the flashback, Chef Barinov crudely boasts to the cooks about wanting to hit on a beautiful guest at the bar, right before Nagiyev introduces her as Kristina.

scenes.title: Нагиев решает сделать предложение  (Nagiyev Decides to Propose)
scenes.summary: Continuing the flashback, Nagiyev confides in Chef Barinov and Vika that he wants to propose marriage to Kristina that evening with an expensive diamond ring.

scenes.title: Кольцо в пирожном под ответственность Шефа  (The Ring in the Pastry Under the Chef's Responsibility)
scenes.summary: Vika suggests hiding the engagement ring inside Kristina's favorite pastry, and Nagiyev entrusts the expensive ring to Chef Barinov until dessert.

scenes.title: Сеня съедает пирожное с кольцом  (Senya Eats the Pastry with the Ring)
scenes.summary: While Chef Barinov steps away, chronic food-snatcher Senya eats the special dessert pastry on the counter and accidentally swallows Nagiyev's diamond engagement ring.

scenes.title: Паника вокруг проглоченного кольца  (Panic Over the Swallowed Ring)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov drags Senya into the restroom demanding the ring back immediately, while Vika tries to stall until Nagiyev bursts in demanding his ring.

scenes.title: Слабительное для Сени  (A Laxative for Senya)
scenes.summary: Nagiyev explodes when he learns Senya swallowed the ring and joins Chef Barinov in forcing Senya to drink a folk laxative concoction while Kristina waits at the table.

scenes.title: Тайник Сени и предложение без пирожного  (Senya's Hiding Spot and a Proposal Without Pastry)
scenes.summary: While the flashback shows Nagiyev giving up on the pastry, in the present Chef Barinov tells Lyova how that disaster paradoxically failed to stop Nagiyev from marrying Kristina.

scenes.title: Тост за вселенную и счёт за коньяк  (A Toast to the Universe and the Cognac Bill)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov jokes to Lyova that the entire universe tried to stop Nagiyev from marrying Kristina, and in the dining room the bartender hands Max the bill for the expensive cognac he drank.

scenes.title: Урок для Сени и пропавшая тысяча  (A Lesson for Senya and the Missing Thousand)
scenes.summary: The cooks force Senya to pay the bar bill with his entire salary as punishment for stealing food, while Chef Barinov discovers a thousand rubles missing from his office stash.
